answer: Agent economies resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to complete a sustained voyage of original graded work that peers must attest before standing is granted. A fake identity cannot simply appear; the attacker must invest the full cost of generating distinct coherent reasoning for every clone, akin to carving rare onyx that takes time and skill. A sudden swarm fails without each carrying its own grove of proven history that cannot be copied and must be earned through repeated effort that scales with the number of fakes.
